modules.title: 消息发出后，谁把它取出来并完成工作
消费者负责接收、处理和反馈

items.title: 先定位堆积从哪里来
items.text: 生产者只把消息发送到队列；如果没有消费者，或消费者处理速度跟不上，消息就会持续堆积。

items.title: 处理后确认结果
items.text: 消费者收到消息后调用处理逻辑，成功时确认已经处理；失败时由系统按规则重新投递或记录失败，不能假装任务已经完成。

items.title: 改善要看链路证据
items.text: 模拟一条消息，能在日志或状态中看到发送、接收、处理和结果反馈，队列堆积也能回落；消费者不是队列本身，一个应用还可能同时是生产者。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 发送成功不等于消费完成，确认也不等于你的业务副作用天然不会重复。消费者是否在线、是否处理失败和失败后如何重投，都要结合实际状态检查。

lessonPractice.title: 生产者显示发送成功，但队列里的任务越来越多。先检查哪一部分？

options.label: 检查消费者是否在线、是否收到消息、处理是否失败以及是否反馈结果
options.feedback: 对。生产者成功发送只说明消息进入了队列，堆积还可能来自无人消费或消费处理不过来。

options.label: 让生产者不断重发同一批消息，直到队列数量下降
options.feedback: 重发会增加堆积，不能证明消费者已经收到或处理了消息。

options.label: 直接清空队列，先让监控数字恢复正常
options.feedback: 清空会丢掉尚未处理的任务，绕过了对消费者状态和失败原因的检查。

en.title: The producer reports success, but the queue keeps growing. What should you inspect first?

options.label: Check whether consumers are online, receiving messages, failing, and reporting results
options.feedback: Correct. Producer success only means the message entered the queue; buildup can come from no consumer or slow processing.

options.label: Have the producer resend the same messages until the queue shrinks
options.feedback: Resending increases buildup and does not show that a consumer received or processed the messages.

options.label: Clear the queue so the monitoring number looks normal again
options.feedback: Clearing can discard unprocessed work and avoids checking the consumer or the failure cause.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 检查这条消息队列的消费者：确认消费者已启动并持续接收消息，处理成功会反馈完成，处理失败不会静默丢失而是按规则重投或记录失败。模拟一条消息，验收它从发送、接收、处理到结果反馈的完整链路。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Inspect the consumer for this message queue: confirm it starts and keeps receiving messages, reports successful processing, and requeues or records failures instead of silently losing them. Simulate one message and verify the full path from publish to delivery, processing, and result feedback.

learning.assumes: You know an application can hand work to a message queue first.
learning.outcome: You can locate the consumer in the send, receive, process, and acknowledge path, and use buildup and redelivery to judge it.

modules.title: Who takes a message and completes the work after it is sent?
A consumer receives, processes, and reports

items.title: Locate the source of buildup
items.text: The producer only sends a message to the queue. If no consumer is running, or consumers are slower than publishing, messages keep accumulating.

items.title: Acknowledge after processing
items.text: The consumer runs the handler and acknowledges success. On failure, the system can redeliver or record the failure under its rules instead of pretending the work finished.

items.title: Judge improvement by evidence
items.text: A simulated message should show publish, delivery, processing, and result feedback in logs or status, while buildup falls. A consumer is not the queue; one application can also publish.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Successful publishing is not completed consumption, and an acknowledgement does not by itself make business side effects impossible to repeat. Check consumer health, processing failures, and redelivery rules.

distinctions.label: Enqueue
distinctions.text: {c:enqueue} is the producer operation placing tasks into a queue; a {c:message-consumer} is the background worker picking up and processing queued tasks.
